# Object Storage Service (OBS)

## Compiled truth

Object Storage Service (OBS) is Huawei Cloud's object storage service [S:afd945968c0ca7b9]. OBS provides storage classes named Standard, Infrequent Access and Archive [S:afd945968c0ca7b9]. A single object stored in OBS can be up to 48.8 TB in size [S:afd945968c0ca7b9]. Buckets in OBS are named with globally unique DNS-compliant names [S:afd945968c0ca7b9]. OBS buckets are accessed over HTTPS through endpoints of the form obs.<region>.myhuaweicloud.com, for example obs.la-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com [S:afd945968c0ca7b9]. OBS is available in the LATAM region LA-Sao Paulo1 [S:afd945968c0ca7b9]. The OBS management console, APIs, SDKs, tools and third-party ecosystem are documented on the Huawei Cloud international documentation site, and OBS product pages live under www.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/product/obs.html [S:afd945968c0ca7b9].
